Each entry names its evidence; tools/port_current/generate_current_symbol_scopes.py applies it and tools/validate_game_symbols_hint_contract.py (build-wired) fails when the generated scopes are stale. Evidence was produced with tools/port_current/symbol_remap/native_body.py NativeSide over artifacts/port_current/idx2_{golden,live}/gen/native_addresses.tsv and the matching GameAssembly.dll (golden D47706EB..., live BB4EA1F5...).

ModBugReporting.ScreenStaticAutoSend.evidence: Signature changed and split (remap: no same-signature member in its order gap). Golden BhBugReportScreen.Method_Public_Static_Void_Boolean_0 (token 100687699, native tjd, CallerCount 1, 13 xrefs) has a 47-instruction body that allocates the capture iterator +cpd, runs its .ctor and tail-jumps to the static coroutine queue et.Enqueue; the bool is not stored. Live 25061458 has two parameterless statics with that same body fingerprint (47 instructions, identical callee shapes, immediates and metadata-usage count; each CallerCount 1, 13 xrefs): Method_Public_Static_Void_0 (token 100687863, native tnu) allocates +cpk and Method_Public_Static_Void_1 (token 100687864, native tnv) allocates +cpl, and both tail-jump to et.Enqueue. The MoveNext of +cpk (token 100687888) and of +cpl (token 100687894) each yield WaitForEndOfFrame, then ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshotAsTexture, Texture2D.ReadPixels/Apply, ImageConversion.EncodeToJPG, Logger2.LogHandler log capture and BhBugReportScreen's log-dictionary builder, then call Hex.SharedLibrary.HexAnalytics.SendReport directly and Debug.Log; they differ only in their encrypted-string helpers. Both are therefore desync auto-send launchers and both must be blocked. The other statics on the type do not send: Show opens the form, tny/tnz only read log files into the report dictionary, and the two static IEnumerator factories have CallerCount 0.

TerrainMaterial.RendererPrepareMap.evidence: Remap refused it as 4 golden vs 2 live same-signature members because identical-code folding gives several metadata methods one native function. Golden renderer beh: Method_Public_Void_Map_Boolean_Boolean_0..3 (tokens 100672698/100672708/100672711/100672717, natives eng/igt/kwh/lsf) are all VA 0x1826C4DA0. Live renderer bei: Method_Public_Void_Map_Boolean_Boolean_0/_1 (tokens 100672711/100672721, natives ghh/kzr) are both VA 0x1827B0020, called directly from Map.okp. Both bodies are 51 instructions with the same shape: null-check the Map, read its width/height (golden Map.oga/ogb, live okh/oki), call the (int,int) sizer (golden kwo, live kzy), then call the first Map pass when the first bool is set (golden kwl, live kzv) and the texture-node upload when the second is set (golden kwm, live kzw). The golden literal _0 therefore names the same native code as live _0 and _1. The dead older natives kwc/jmr/kvo bind nothing.

TerrainMaterial.RendererUploadTextureNod.evidence: Golden Method_Private_Void_Map_0 (native kwm, VA 0x1826CAE40, 118 instructions) is the texture-node upload that PrepareMap (VA 0x1826C4DA0) calls under its second bool. The live PrepareMap (VA 0x1827B0020) calls live Method_Private_Void_Map_1 (native kzw, VA 0x1827B31D0, 118 instructions) at the same call position, and that is its only direct caller. Normalised bodies differ only in build-renamed callees (Map.oga/ogb/ogk -> okh/oki/okr) and one metadata reference. The live 118-instruction PDM copies (dw, myi, nko) have no callers.

TerrainMaterial.RendererRebuildMaterialA.evidence: Golden binds Method_Private_Void_PDM_5 (native jwp, VA 0x1826C8E40): an uncalled 348-instruction copy of the packed-material builder kwj (Method_Private_Void_2, called from the .ctor and the public entry kkd). It differs from kwj only in the loop cap of min(SoTerrainMaterial.biomes.Count, cap): kwj 16, jwp 30 (the 30-slot builder of docs/offlineunlockmod_dll_provenance.md 2026-06-08). Live has the same builder kzt (Method_Private_Void_0, 348 instructions, called from the .ctor and the public entry kzs, cap 16) and uncalled copies car (Method_Private_Void_PDM_5, cap 65) and kas (Method_Private_Void_PDM_2, cap 63). Normalised bodies differ only in that cap and the renamed owner type. The plugin fails closed when the active biome count exceeds NativePackedMaterialSlotLimit (16) and expands packed state to 32. So every reachable count is below both golden jwp's cap and live car's cap, and live car behaves as golden jwp. It also keeps the interop name that RendererPackedBuildStatePrepMethodNames keys on. nac/ivz/kwe/bbd/hpm/ne are dead older natives.

TerrainMaterial.RendererPackedBuildState.evidence: Names the same method as TerrainMaterial.RendererRebuildMaterialArrays: golden jwp -> live car, both interop Method_Private_Void_PDM_5 on the terrain renderer. See that entry's evidence.

TerrainSound.HeroBiomeBuildMap.evidence: Golden hero-biome sound type ezc (ObjectPublicEHciMaItciEHciEHUnique) binds Method_Public_Void_Map_PDM_0 (native bicq, VA 0x1821F8710, 71 instructions: Map.oga/ogb, then the tile lookup ezc.bicr).
